operations.title: Exact n=8 global-orientation to D03-costalk audit
The global orientation line tensored with the independent polarity deck line has the abstract local character chi_N=(+1,-1,-1).
At D=03 the four global local-square boundaries restrict onto the full saturated local A2 road-difference lattice.
Ordinary graph-star restriction neither descends to a road-valued map from the global orientation quotient nor induces a primitive road counit; its quotient-to-quotient map is zero.
Character agreement does not determine the six alternating-conductor supports: representatives of one global primitive class give distinct local A2 and six-term vectors.
Compute the primitive orientation quotient, polarity-loaded character, D03 stabilizer, star restriction, quotient map, and six-support ambiguity.
